subject: CS353
filterSummary: Selected 9 out of 10 possible videos. For English, all topics were well-covered with highly relevant, popular videos. For Arabic, coverage was good for TSP, Assignment Problem, and DFS. For the Knapsack problem, a video was selected under the view count exception as it was the only relevant option. No Arabic videos were found for the Closest-Pair Problem.

coverage.note: Selected under view count exception (1318 views) as no other relevant candidates exist.
Only one candidate found teaching brute force; others teach Hungarian method.
No candidates found for this topic in Arabic.
